hero.headline: Verification and repair
hero.description: Metris Lab provides verification, calibration, diagnostics, and repair of portable and fixed gas analyzers. We help return instruments to service, prepare documents for inspections, and reduce equipment downtime.

about.label: Who we help
about.headline: Gas analyzers must work
about.description1: We support enterprises, laboratories, occupational safety, industrial safety, and environmental teams. We check gas analyzer condition, identify causes of errors, perform adjustment, repair, and verification with clear technical support.
about.description2: If the verification period has expired, readings are unstable, self-test fails, or documents are required for an inspection, we help define the scope and prepare the equipment for operation.
about.tech3_value: O2, CO, H2S, CH4 and more

services.label: What we do
services.headline: Turnkey gas analyzer service
services.description: We cover the key tasks for gas analytical equipment: from first diagnostics to verification, repair, calibration, and document preparation.
services.s1_desc: Verification of portable and fixed gas analyzers for occupational safety, industrial safety, environmental control, and production monitoring.
services.s2_desc: We check sensors, electronics, power, pumps, filters, and reading stability to define whether repair is possible and how long it may take.
services.s3_desc: We restore instrument operation, replace consumables, resolve errors, and prepare equipment for return to service.
services.s4_desc: We adjust sensitivity and reading correctness using gas mixtures, checking response and measurement stability.
services.s5_desc: We help prepare instruments and documents for internal audits, inspections, and industrial safety requirements.
services.s6_desc: We build regular verification and service schedules so gas analyzers do not drop out of operation unexpectedly.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: What to know before gas analyzer verification
faq.q1: Can you tell whether repair is needed before verification?
faq.a1: Usually this is clear after initial diagnostics. If self-test fails, readings are unstable, or the instrument does not respond to gas mixture, diagnostics and possible repair come first.
faq.q2: Which gas analyzers can be serviced?
faq.a2: We review portable and fixed gas analyzers for O2, CO, H2S, CH4, and other gases. Provide the model in the request and we will check feasibility.
faq.q3: What documents does the customer receive?
faq.a3: The document set depends on the task and work type. We clarify what is required for operation, internal audit, or inspection in advance.
faq.q4: Can multiple instruments be serviced at once?
faq.a4: Yes. For enterprises, it is usually more convenient to send instruments in batches and maintain a verification schedule.
